nodes.label: Oki Creator Localization Engine
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/corpus/Oki Creator Localization Engine — Technical Playbook & SOW.pdf
nodes.rationale: Licensed localization and distribution system that preserves creator ownership while Oki performs translation, dubbing, editing, publishing, attribution, analytics, and payouts; applicable rights must be recorded and approved before processing.

nodes.label: Creator Channel Localization
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/corpus/Oki Creator Localization Engine — Technical Playbook & SOW.pdf
nodes.rationale: Preferred model: localized audio, subtitles, metadata, and approved Oki integration stay on the creator channel; creator retains YouTube revenue while Oki acquires users via unique attribution.

nodes.label: Licensed Regional Channel
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/corpus/Oki Creator Localization Engine — Technical Playbook & SOW.pdf
nodes.rationale: Official licensed regional channel using creator name, image, and content with written permission; revenue follows contract and monetization is not guaranteed.

nodes.label: Original Local Adaptation
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/corpus/Oki Creator Localization Engine — Technical Playbook & SOW.pdf
nodes.rationale: Creates standalone local value through new introduction, host, explanations, examples, graphics, and conclusions, reducing reused-content dependence.

nodes.label: Rights Gate
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/corpus/Oki Creator Localization Engine — Technical Playbook & SOW.pdf
nodes.rationale: Rights are validated before any production activity; the system fails closed and blocks missing, pending, expired, revoked, or scope-incompatible permissions.

nodes.label: RIGHTS_APPROVED
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/corpus/Oki Creator Localization Engine — Technical Playbook & SOW.pdf
nodes.rationale: Mandatory system status before production.

nodes.label: SPONSOR_REPLACEMENT_APPROVED
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/corpus/Oki Creator Localization Engine — Technical Playbook & SOW.pdf
nodes.rationale: Every advertisement replacement requires distinct approval equal to TRUE.

nodes.label: Sponsorship Rights
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/corpus/Oki Creator Localization Engine — Technical Playbook & SOW.pdf
nodes.rationale: Agreement must specify deletion/replacement scope, author-voice statements, voice clone use, approval requirements, and future-template reuse.

nodes.label: LICENSED_NEUTRAL_VOICE
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/corpus/Oki Creator Localization Engine — Technical Playbook & SOW.pdf
nodes.rationale: Default licensed professional narrator or licensed TTS voice.

nodes.label: CREATOR_APPROVED_CLONE
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/corpus/Oki Creator Localization Engine — Technical Playbook & SOW.pdf
nodes.rationale: Creator voice permitted only after separate written consent.

nodes.label: HUMAN_VOICE_ACTOR
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/corpus/Oki Creator Localization Engine — Technical Playbook & SOW.pdf
nodes.rationale: Human voice actor used under a recording-use agreement.

nodes.label: Voice Rights Fail-Closed
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/corpus/Oki Creator Localization Engine — Technical Playbook & SOW.pdf
nodes.rationale: The default is LICENSED_NEUTRAL_VOICE and generation must fail closed when the chosen voice mode lacks permissions.
